title: Ceva theorem extension to non-Euclidean geometries

problemStatement.plain: Extension of Ceva/Menelaus theorems to spherical and hyperbolic geometries, with Gauss-Bonnet connection.

proven: Spherical Menelaus: sin-ratio product = 1 ↔ sin(BD)·sin(CE)·sin(AF) = sin(DC)·sin(EA)·sin(FB)
Hyperbolic Menelaus: sinh-ratio product = 1 ↔ sinh version
Ceva-Menelaus duality: negating one ratio converts one to the other
Gauss-Bonnet: angle_sum = π + κ·Area for constant curvature κ
Sign consistency: sign of κ determines whether angle sum exceeds/equals/falls below π
